patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts with large, impactful headings on one side and supporting content or interactive elements on the other, often within a full-bleed dark background.

Prominent, oversized sans-serif headings (Inter) are used for key messages, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, readable body text and distinct monospace elements for technical details.

A high-contrast palette features deep dark backgrounds (#050505, #111111) paired with bright white text, punctuated by vibrant accent colors like electric green (#25fc54) and reddish-orange (#ff5d48) for CTAs and highlights.

The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport upon scroll. In the hero section, a central interactive card appears to be fixed in the viewport while the background image behind it scrolls, creating a subtle parallax effect.
Alternating full-width sections between very dark backgrounds and lighter grey backgrounds, providing clear visual separation and rhythm down the page.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls. The hero section features a fixed-position interactive element (a card) that stays centered while a background image behind it scrolls, creating a layered parallax effect. Other content sections reveal themselves by scrolling normally into view.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong impact, with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, readable body text and distinct monospace labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like buttons and cards feature slightly rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a tighter density within card components.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, high-contrast aesthetic, combining deep dark backgrounds with stark white typography and vibrant, almost neon, accent colors. The use of a fixed interactive element within a parallaxing hero background creates a unique visual anchor that immediately draws attention and sets a modern, tech-forward tone.
